translations.web: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
translations.bsb: Whoever loves his life will lose it, but whoever hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
translations.kjv: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
translations.asv: He that loveth his life loseth it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
